```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(vitae)
library(tibble)
library(magrittr)

bullets <- function(...) {
  x <- unlist(list(...))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  
  tibble::tibble(what = x) %>%
    vitae::brief_entries(what = what)
}
```

# EDUCATION

```{r}
tribble(
  ~date, ~degree, ~school, ~location, ~details,

  "Expected May 2026",
  "Bachelor of Arts in Psychology",
  "Wake Forest University",
  "Winston-Salem, NC",
  c("GPA: 3.69 | Dean’s List"),

  "Fall 2024",
  "Study Abroad",
  "Danish Institute for Study Abroad (DIS)",
  "Copenhagen, Denmark",
  c("Coursework in well-being psychology and the cognitive psychology of decision-making.")
) %>%
  detailed_entries(
    where = date,
    with  = degree,
    what  = paste0(school, " — ", location),
    why   = details
  )
```
